claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Charley Davis, champion of the United Kingdom, for the championship of the world and £200 a side at St. George Hall, under the remodeled London prize ring rules with hard gloves.

fights.notes: Davis was knocked down senseless in the fifth round; his friends rushed the ring and cries of foul were raised, but the referee declared Allen the winner.

notes: Dispatch from a Cincinnati Enquirer special; OCR is heavily damaged in places.
